summary: Implemented prepareUpdate per the spec. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: new Update container class (prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update; the empty-request path applies translatePrologue to q.prologue[0] before returning an empty algebra list; the non-empty path returns the cumulative prologue and the algebra list. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, recording _original_args; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update needed no change. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py added with tests for prepare+Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs resolution, initial bindings, direct evaluation, non-empty container shape, empty container, declarations-only prefix binding, empty string through Graph.update/processUpdate, and a no-mutation snapshot check. Nothing was run: tests, the existing prepareQuery test, and DAWG update tests still need execution, and black formatting was checked by eye only. No commit was made.
